provenance: veg-palette-mc2_01 lane, 2026-11-10. Land swatches: 9-cluster k-means over land pixels (water/sky hue excluded) of four day captures at base 2247a9a73 (bookmarks mc2_01_owner_lowwide, _zoom, mc2_01_saved_205644, _reverse). Stock foliage swatches: 15/50/85th percentile of green-dominant pixels in the stock palm crown and the hill treeline of the owner_lowwide_zoom capture. Species ramps are hand-picked from these swatches (screen-space, lit colours); the vegetation shader exposes cards by ground luma / ground_luma.
grass_reference: Owner 2026-11-10 grass-field reference (E:/mc2-archive-2026-10/proofs/grass-field/owner_reference.jpg): straw/gold dominant, olive-green near the roots, scattered rust blades and seed heads, backlit tips. Its bright saturated gold is pulled toward mc2_01's overcast khaki (palm frond khaki #6d613d .. light sand #706040 family, lifted for contrast); its green toward the palm-frond olive; rust kept but darkened.
